query: I want my AI assistant to read and search files in a local project folder.
I need my assistant to inspect GitHub issues and pull requests for a software project.
I want to ask natural-language questions about data stored in a PostgreSQL database.
I have a local SQLite database and want my assistant to inspect its tables and query the data.
I need an agent that can open websites, click buttons, fill forms, and read the resulting pages.
I want my assistant to search the public web and return relevant pages with links.
I want my assistant to search our Slack conversations and summarize recent messages from a channel.
I need my assistant to find and read documents stored in Google Drive.
I want my assistant to search and read pages from our Notion workspace.
I want my AI assistant to remember useful facts and retrieve them in later sessions.
I need my assistant to look up Jira tickets and their current status.
I want my assistant to check my calendar and tell me what meetings I have scheduled.
I need my assistant to search my email and summarize messages related to a project.
I want my assistant to inspect running Docker containers and show me their logs.
I need my assistant to inspect a Kubernetes cluster, list workloads, and read pod logs.
I want my assistant to list files in an S3-compatible bucket and download objects when needed.
I need my assistant to call REST APIs and inspect the JSON responses.
I want to give my assistant a URL and have it extract the main readable content from the page.
I want my assistant to search through a code repository and explain where a feature is implemented.
I need my assistant to search Google Sheets data and read values from selected spreadsheets.
On my Mac, I want the assistant to read one approved local folder, but it must never create, edit, move, or delete files.
constraints: macOS compatible; scope access to an approved folder; read-only; no create/edit/move/delete

query: I need email search and summarization, but the integration must not send, delete, archive, or modify any messages.
constraints: read-only email access; no send; no delete; no archive; no message modification

query: I need access to a private GitHub repository to inspect code, issues, and pull requests, but the assistant must not push commits or modify repository content.
constraints: private repository support; read-only repository access; no push or content modification

query: I want an assistant to analyze a production PostgreSQL database using SELECT queries only; it must not run INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL, or schema changes.
constraints: PostgreSQL support; SELECT-only access; no writes; no DDL or schema changes

query: I want web search from my local assistant without opening a browser UI, and I strongly prefer a solution that does not require a paid search API key.
constraints: no interactive browser UI; prefer no paid search API key

query: I need browser automation that can run headlessly inside a Linux Docker environment and still handle JavaScript-heavy pages.
constraints: headless operation; Linux compatible; Docker-compatible deployment; support dynamic JavaScript pages

query: I want the assistant to read and search Slack channels, but it must not post messages, react, edit, or delete anything.
constraints: read-only Slack access; no posting; no reactions; no editing or deletion

query: I want the assistant to search a specific Google Drive or Shared Drive and read documents, while keeping access limited to that approved drive.
constraints: scope access to a specific Drive or Shared Drive; read-only preferred

query: I need persistent memory for an assistant, but the stored memory must stay on my own machine and must not be sent to a third-party cloud service.
constraints: local persistence; no third-party cloud storage

query: I only need calendar free/busy information for scheduling; the assistant must not create, edit, move, or cancel events.
constraints: read-only calendar access; free/busy or event reading only; no event changes

query: I want to inspect Docker container status, configuration, and logs, but the assistant must not start, stop, restart, remove, or create containers.
constraints: read-only Docker operations; no container lifecycle changes

query: I need Kubernetes visibility for one namespace only: list pods, deployments, events, and logs, with no ability to change cluster resources.
constraints: scope to one namespace; read-only Kubernetes access; no resource mutation

query: I want the assistant to access one S3 bucket with permission to list and download objects only; uploading or deleting objects must be impossible.
constraints: scope to one bucket; list/download only; no upload; no delete

query: I need an HTTP integration for internal APIs, but requests must be restricted to an explicit allowlist of approved hosts rather than arbitrary internet addresses.
constraints: host allowlist; no arbitrary destination access

query: I want to search and read our Notion knowledge base, but the integration should not create, edit, move, or delete pages.
constraints: read-only Notion access; no page creation/edit/move/delete

query: I need Jira integration that can read issues and add comments, but it must not delete issues or change workflow status.
constraints: read issues; allow comments; no issue deletion; no workflow transitions

query: I need to extract content from public web pages with minimal runtime overhead; I do not want to launch a full browser unless the page truly requires JavaScript.
constraints: prefer lightweight fetching; avoid full browser when unnecessary

query: I want to query a MySQL-compatible database through the assistant, but database credentials must come from environment variables rather than being embedded in prompts or configuration committed to source control.
constraints: MySQL-compatible; credentials from environment or secure secret source; no credentials in prompts/source control

query: I need the assistant to retrieve secrets from a vault for deployment tasks, but it must not expose secret values in logs or persist them in its own memory.
constraints: secure vault access; no secret logging; no persistent storage of secret values

query: I need a code execution tool for untrusted snippets, but execution must be sandboxed so the code cannot access my host filesystem or unrestricted network resources.
constraints: sandboxed execution; no host filesystem access; no unrestricted network access

query: I want ChatGPT to help me work with files on my laptop.
I need something that lets my assistant help with our GitHub project.
Can my assistant check information in our database for me?
I want the agent to look things up on the web when it does research.
I want the assistant to remember important things I told it before.
I want the assistant to help me keep up with messages from my team.
I need an assistant that can inspect resources in our cloud environment.
I want my assistant to help me see what is happening with our containers.
Can the assistant check what is running in our Kubernetes cluster?
I need the assistant to find information in our internal documentation.
I want the assistant to help me figure out when I am free for a meeting.
I want to ask the assistant questions about emails I have received.
I need the agent to pull useful information out of websites for research.
I want the assistant to help me keep track of project tickets.
I want to ask questions about data in our analytics warehouse.
I need the assistant to check logs when something in our system goes wrong.
I want the assistant to work with a few internal APIs we use at work.
I need the assistant to use a website the way a person would, not just download the page text.
I want the assistant to search our company knowledge base and bring back the relevant pages.
I want the assistant to look up values in shared spreadsheets when I ask a question.
